issue.title: Prime thinking adapter: live THINKER prompts draw tool markup into deep-focus answers
issue.symptom: Deep focus (a person asks GAIA to focus/think hard → Prime thinks natively with prime_thinking_v1) works end to end as of 2026-10-29: 2 of 2 live probes thought (1.9k/4.8k chars), first answer correct (marbles=9, 36 s turn). But on live THINKER prompts (dev persona, tool schema, history, grounding; ~1.4-5k tokens vs the teacher's ~0.3-1k) the adapter sometimes (a) wraps its answer in a fabricated <tool_result>{"response": ...} block, (b) earlier opened with THOUGHT_SEED + <tool_calling> instead of thinking. Same class as w6in (adapter distilled on prompts that differ from the live deliberation prompt). Fix direction: teacher round on prompts captured from the live deliberation path (dump messages from deliberate()), and/or a voice-path guard that strips a self-written <tool_result> wrapper. Engine-side loop/prefill/health fixes already landed (gaia-engine, same day).

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/tests/test_deliberation_fake_tool_result.py
"""b9mp: a <tool_result> in the model's own deliberation answer is made up
(only the system writes one). It is dropped, and an answer that was nothing
else falls back like an empty one."""
from gaia_core.cognition.deliberation import deliberate


def _run(content):
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": "You are GAIA."},
            {"role": "user", "content": "How much is the ball?"}]
    return deliberate("How much is the ball?", msgs, _Pool(content), model_role="prime",
                      persist=False, offer_tools=False, native_thinking=True)


def test_fake_result_only_falls_back():
    r = _run("<tool_result>...</tool_result>")
    assert r.final_response == ""
    assert r.fallback_used


def test_fake_result_dropped_from_real_answer():
    r = _run("<tool_result>price: 0.05</tool_result>\nThe ball costs $0.05.")
    assert "tool_result" not in r.final_response
    assert "$0.05" in r.final_response
    assert not r.fallback_used


def test_unclosed_fake_result_dropped():
    r = _run("<tool_result>{\"answer\": 5}")
    assert r.final_response == ""
    assert r.fallback_used


def test_plain_answer_untouched():
    r = _run("The ball costs $0.05.")
    assert r.final_response == "The ball costs $0.05."
    assert not r.fallback_used

+++ b/candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/deliberation.py
@@ -729,6 +729,14 @@ def deliberate(
         if native_thinking:
             logger.info("Deliberation: native thinking requested but no thought channel returned")
         thinking, final_response, fallback_used = _split_think_and_response(raw)
+    # b9mp: only the system writes a <tool_result>. One in the model's own
+    # answer is made up (the tools block shows the tag); drop it, and an
+    # answer that was nothing else falls back like an empty one.
+    if _FAKE_RESULT_RE.search(final_response or ""):

     final_response = _strip_leading_input_echo(final_response, user_input)

@@ -798,6 +806,9 @@ def _flag(value) -> bool:
     return str(value).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
 
 
+_FAKE_RESULT_RE = re.compile(r"<tool_(?:result|response)>.*?(?:</tool_(?:result|response)>|$)", re.I | re.S)
+
+
